desc:
💼 Welcome to Steal an Employee! 💼

How to Play:
🏃 Sneak into companies and steal their employees
😱 Escape the boss before he catches you!
🎉 Reveal your new hire — is it a Legendary?
🪑 Seat employees at desks to earn cash
📈 Upgrade desks and expand your office for more income
⚡ Buy speed and cars to run faster
🌙 New rare employees appear every night
🔨 Bonk other players to steal their employees
💰 Collect offline earnings from your vault
✨ Hunt for Secret, Mythic, and Divine employees!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite for updates!
